The '''''Spinward''-class tender''' was a mobile repair ship used by the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] nearly 100 years after the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. As large as [[Bulk freighter/Legends|bulk freighters]], these tenders performed major repairs on damaged Alliance warships.

==Characteristics==
The ''Spinward''-class tender was designed to perform deep space repairs for large [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] and [[Transport/Legends|transports]]. Using massive ship-mounted robotic arms and onboard [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beams]], the ''Spinward'' could latch on to a damaged starship and immediately begin repairs. The ship carried zero-g repair crews equipped with [[Environment suit/Legends|EVA suits]] or repair pods, various types of [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]] or repair droids, and standard technicians. Each ''Spinward'' carried numerous repair materials, including spare parts and hull plating. While not as effective as a [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]] or spacedock, the ''Spinward'' was critical for organizations that lack the necessary infrastructure, like the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]].<ref name="LECG" />

==History==
''Spinward''-class tenders were stationed at the [[Black Redoubt]], a secret deep space repair and maintenance facility operated by the Galactic Alliance Remnant.<ref name="LECG" />
